record.question: Who is in-charge of Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions?
record.explanation: Answer B: Narendra Modi. The President’s 3 September 2017 portfolio allocation assigns Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, matching the 2018 paper context. Historical/source note: Historical portfolio, not a present cabinet claim. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1501597&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
